spoken_summary: Senator Maggie Hassan forcefully states that President Trump is "unilaterally freezing all federal grants," an act she calls illegal. She explains that the president is required to spend money appropriated by Congress, citing the Impoundment Control Act and a Supreme Court ruling that found it constitutional. Hassan argues this action will hurt people across the country by defunding police departments, imperiling disaster relief, halting cancer research, and shutting down shelters for homeless veterans.
